description: This file defines a SessionStorage class in Dart, responsible for managing user session data such as authentication tokens and user information using SharedPreferences for persistence in a Flutter application.

classes.name: SessionStorage
classes.description: A class to handle storing and retrieving session data such as tokens and user info through persistent local storage.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to asynchronously create and initialize a SessionStorage instance with SharedPreferences.

methods.name: saveSession
methods.description: Saves the provided AuthToken and User objects into shared preferences as JSON strings.

methods.name: readToken
methods.description: Reads the authentication token from shared preferences, decoding the JSON into an AuthToken object if available.

methods.name: readUser
methods.description: Reads the user data from shared preferences, decoding the JSON into a User object if available.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes the stored token and user data from shared preferences.
